heading: Doctors
description: The doctors of this hospital, their departments and their working hours.

form.departmentsFailed: The departments could not be loaded.
form.departmentsUnavailable: You do not have access to this hospital's departments, so a department cannot be chosen.
form.registrationHint: Optional. The medical council registration number.
form.consultationHint: How long one appointment usually takes. Scheduling uses it for slots.

create.heading: Add a doctor
create.description: Choose a staff member of this hospital and fill in their profile as a doctor. To add someone who has no account yet, invite them first.
create.staffNone: No staff member without a doctor profile matches.
create.staffFailed: The staff list could not be loaded.
create.exists: This staff member already has a doctor profile.
create.invalid: The staff member or the department is no longer available. Choose again.

detail.notFoundBody: There is no such doctor at this hospital.
detail.errorTitle: The doctor could not be loaded
detail.inactiveNote: This doctor no longer practises here. They stay on past records and are not offered for new appointments.
detail.conflict: Someone else changed this profile while you were editing. What you changed is still here: check it and save again. The fields you did not change keep what they saved.
detail.conflictToggle: Someone else changed this profile just now. It has been updated: check it and try again.

hours.heading: Working hours
hours.description: Regular weekly hours, in this hospital's time. A day with no hours is a day off.
hours.failed: The working hours could not be loaded.
hours.conflict: Someone else changed these hours while you were editing. What you entered is still here: check it, and save again to replace theirs.

errors.incomplete: Give both a start and an end time.
errors.order: A session must end after it starts.
errors.overlap: Two sessions on this day overlap.
